review_description: Our panels have been full of condensation since installation in July 2014 and have an ongoing battle to get the situation rectified, concerned with corrosion and panels not working 100% efficiently.  I would not recommend this company or the Ecosmart Solar system - there is no support.

Grant Chugg from Grant Chugg Plumbing came to my house - and did a comprehensive overview and quoted for a system that I will be going with within the next 12 months.This team offer information, excellent customer care and followup - I recommend them.I used the 3 solar suppliers that were suggested through this site and their service was dreadful.  Poor communication and no followup.Your website was fastastic to get the process rolling - but in the end I found the company that I will be going with.
